# Penn State PURE

> > Penn State's research information system showcasing faculty profiles, research organizations, centers, and scholarly activities across University Park, College of Medicine, and campus locations.

PURE (Penn State University Research Explorer) serves as the comprehensive research database for Penn State, documenting departments, research centers, medical divisions, and scholarly work across disciplines including health sciences, engineering, food science, humanities, and more. The system connects researchers, organizations, and activities across the entire Penn State system.

## Key Topics

- Penn State College of Medicine
- Penn State Health
- Anesthesiology and Perioperative Medicine
- Radiation Science & Engineering Center
- One Health Microbiome Center
- Penn State Neuroscience Institute
- College of Health and Human Development
- Nuclear Engineering and Neutron Research
- Liver Transplantation
- Food Science and Food Microbiology
- Division of Cardiac & Vascular Anesthesia
- Research Centers
- Faculty Profiles
- Department of Public Health Sciences

## Medical and Health Sciences Organizations

- [Division of Cardiac & Vascular Anesthesia](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/division-of-cardiac-vascular-anesthesia): Division specializing in cardiac, vascular, and transplant anesthesiology
- [Division of Transplantation](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/division-of-transplantation): Surgery division specializing in liver, kidney, and heart transplants
- [Division of Transplant Anesthesia](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/division-of-transplant-anesthesia): Anesthesiology division specializing in transplant and perioperative care
- [Division of Pediatric Complex Care](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/division-of-pediatric-complex-care): Pediatrics division researching childhood obesity and parenting interventions
- [Division of Pediatric Orthopaedics](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/division-of-pediatric-orthopaedics): Pediatric orthopaedics division researching injury and combat trauma
- [Communication Sciences and Disorders](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/communication-sciences-and-disorders): Dept researching autism, speech-language pathology, and AAC

## Research Centers and Institutes

- [Radiation Science & Engineering Center](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/radiation-science-engineering-center): Research center for nuclear engineering and neutron research at Penn State
- [Center for Nanothread Chemistry](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/center-for-nanothread-chemistry): Research center for carbon nanothreads and high-pressure synthesis
- [Survey Research Center](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/survey-research-center): SSRI center conducting sexual health and HIV prevention research

## Agricultural and Nutritional Sciences

- [Food Science](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/food-science): Food Science dept in College of Agricultural Sciences with research focus
- [Nutritional Sciences](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/nutritional-sciences): Nutritional Sciences dept researching obesity, vitamin A, cardiovascular health

## Arts, Humanities, and Social Sciences

- [Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/classics-and-ancient-mediterranean-studies): Dept studying classics, archaeology, and ancient Mediterranean cultures
- [Division of Arts & Humanities (Altoona)](https://pure.psu.edu/en/organisations/division-of-arts-humanities-altoona): Arts & Humanities division at Penn State Altoona campus

## Optional

- [International Conference of Auditory Display 2017 - conference chair](https://pure.psu.edu/en/activities/international-conference-of-auditory-display-2017-conference-chai): Mark Ballora chairs International Conference of Auditory Display 2017
- [A Holistic Approach to Diversity and Inclusiveness](https://pure.psu.edu/en/activities/a-holistic-approach-to-diversity-and-inclusiveness-2): Chappell-Williams presents on diversity at Beijing conference
- [Does Sleep Quality Moderate the Effect of Vitamin D Intake on Risk for Dementia?](https://pure.psu.edu/en/activities/does-sleep-quality-moderate-the-effect-of-vitamin-d-intake-on-ris): Chen Zhao presents on sleep quality, vitamin D, and dementia risk
